messages.text: Which of your miners is quietest for a home office, and what does it cost?
Searched the catalog · quiet home crypto miner low noise

The NerdQX (8TH/s) is the quietest — rated ~40 dB, which is whisper-level, thanks to its dual-fan setup with a copper VREG heatsink built for home use. It's $299.99 and in stock. Everything else in the lineup runs 45-65 dB.

If open-source firmware matters more than a few extra decibels, the NerdQaxe++ (~45 dB, $249) is worth a look too — but for a home office, the NerdQX is your quietest bet.
